I am writing to apply for the Operations Analyst role. I am finishing a full-time MBA in Rotterdam, and before that I spent six years running warehouse operations.

In my last role I led a team of 12 and cut late deliveries by 34% in 18 months. I did it by redesigning the dispatch plan with the team, not around them. I would like to bring the same habit of measuring first and changing second to your planning team.

Your recent move to a second terminal makes planning harder, and that is the kind of problem I enjoy. I would welcome a conversation about how I can help.

Thank you for your time.
